board.title: Your applications
board.lede: Everything your scout is preparing, everything waiting for your tap, and everything already out there.
board.summary: {needs} waiting for you · {submitted} submitted · {progress} in progress
board.emptyBody: Tap “Apply for me” on any opportunity in Scout and it lands here. Or watch the whole flow once with a free practice run against our sandbox form.
board.practiceTitle: See the whole flow once, for free
board.practiceBody: A practice application goes to our own sandbox form, never to a real organisation, and uses no credits.
board.filteredEmpty: No applications for this goal yet.

status.needs_info: {count, plural, one {# quick question for you} other {# quick questions for you}}
status.ready: Ready: review it and tap confirm
status.ready_practice: Ready: review the practice run and submit
status.needs_you_handoff: Your turn: finish it on the official site (a few minutes)
status.needs_you_captcha: A CAPTCHA needs you: finish it on the official site
status.needs_you_login: Needs your login on the official site
status.needs_you_payment: The organiser asks for a fee: you pay it on their site
status.needs_you_no_gmail: Send the email from your own inbox
status.needs_you_followup_approval: A follow-up email is ready for your tap
status.needs_you_organiser_request: The organiser asked you for something
status.needs_you_opportunity_missing: This opportunity is no longer listed
status.progress: In progress: you have a reply

room.practiceNote: Practice run: everything goes to our own sandbox form. Nothing reaches a real organisation and no credits are used.
room.notFoundBody: It may have been removed. Your board has everything that's still open.
room.missingOpportunity: This opportunity is no longer listed. Withdraw it, or keep it for your records.

working.title: Your scout is on it
working.gaps: Checking what your profile already answers…
working.compose: Drafting your documents from your own facts…
working.slow: This one is taking a little longer. You can leave the page: we'll notify you when it's ready.

activity.title: What we did
activity.analyze: Read the application: {fields, plural, =0 {no form fields} one {# field} other {# fields}}, {questions, plural, =0 {no open questions} one {# question} other {# questions}}
activity.gaps: Checked your profile: {settled} answered from your facts, {asked} asked
activity.compose: Drafted {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} from your facts
activity.preview: Prepared the package for your review

questions.title: A few quick taps
questions.lede: Only what this application needs and your profile doesn't say. You answer once; we reuse it next time.
questions.useThese: Use {count, plural, one {this reason} other {these reasons}}
questions.pickUpTo: Pick up to 3 that are true for you
questions.ownPlaceholder: One or two sentences in your own words
questions.fileHint: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, images, ZIP or MP4, up to 20 MB
questions.allDone: Thanks, that's everything. Finishing your application…
questions.moreLater: {count, plural, one {# more question after these} other {# more questions after these}}
questions.uploadFailed: That file didn't upload. Try again.

documents.title: Documents
documents.lede: Every sentence comes from your documents or your own answers. Tap a sentence to see where it came from, or to change it.
documents.empty: No documents for this application: the form only needs your answers.

labels.written_with_ai: Written with AI from your facts

documents.gap: Only you can write this part
documents.noSource: Structure only: no claim about you
documents.fallbackDocx: The Chinese PDF font couldn't load just now, so you got the Word file. It looks the same in Word, WPS or Pages.

answers.title: Answers
answers.lede: What goes into each field of the form, in the form's order. Tap an answer to see where it came from, or to change it.
answers.empty: No form answers needed: the documents carry this application.

email.title: Email
email.lede: Personal, from your own address, to one recipient. Edit anything before it goes.
email.noRecipient: No public email address is listed. Add one you trust before sending.
email.subject: Subject
email.gmailMissing: Gmail isn't connected. Connect it to send from your own address, or open the email in your mail app.
email.followupLede: A short, polite nudge from your own address. It goes only if you tap send.
email.followupSkipped: Skipped. We'll check in again later.

confirm.title: Ready for your tap
confirm.lede: Look over the documents and answers. When you confirm, we submit exactly what you see.
confirm.practiceLede: This is a practice run. When you submit, it goes to our sandbox form and you'll see the confirmation, just like a real one.
confirm.costFree: Free: practice runs never use credits
confirm.balance: You have {count, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} available
confirm.balanceUnknown: Your balance appears in the top bar
confirm.short: You need 1 credit to submit. Credits come back if a submission fails or you withdraw before it goes out.
confirm.fine: By confirming, you ask Onward Scout to submit this application on your behalf with the documents and answers above. The credit is only spent once it is submitted.
confirm.waitingQuestions: Answer the questions first, then you can confirm.
confirm.submitted: Submitted. Nothing else to do right now.
confirm.retryFailed: The last attempt didn't go through. Nothing was sent and the credit is back. Try again when you're ready.
confirm.unsavedEmail: Your email has unsaved changes: they are saved when you confirm.

handoff.title: Your handoff
handoff.lede: This site needs you in person (a login, a CAPTCHA, a payment, or a platform that doesn't allow automation). Everything is prepared in the form's order: copy each field into the official form and submit it — usually a few minutes.

reasons.captcha: The form has a CAPTCHA, which only you can solve.
reasons.login: The site needs your own account to apply.
reasons.payment: The organiser charges an application fee, which you pay on their site.
reasons.unsupported: This platform doesn't allow automated applications, so you submit it yourself.
reasons.blocked: The form changed or blocked automation. Nothing was sent; submit it yourself with everything below.
reasons.no_gmail: Gmail isn't connected, so you send the email from your own inbox.
reasons.handoff: This application is submitted by you, with everything prepared.

handoff.doneLede: Tell us and we'll track it, follow up and keep your board honest.
handoff.screenshot: Add a screenshot of the confirmation (optional)
handoff.credit: This uses the credit reserved when you started the handoff.
handoff.screenshotType: Add the screenshot as a PNG or JPG.
handoff.uploadFailed: The screenshot didn't upload. Try again.

outcome.title: Any news?
outcome.lede: Record what happened in one tap. It moves your milestones and teaches your scout what works.
outcome.followUpsSent: {count, plural, one {# follow-up sent} other {# follow-ups sent}}

withdraw.title: Withdraw this application?
withdraw.body: We'll stop working on it. If it wasn't submitted yet, any reserved credit comes back.
withdraw.bodySubmitted: We'll mark it withdrawn and stop the follow-ups. Tell the organiser yourself if they need to know.

ended.rejected: Not selected this time. It still counts: your scout learns from every outcome.
ended.expired: The deadline passed before it was submitted. No credit was used.

toasts.needsYou: Your turn: finish it on the official site
toasts.failedRetry: The submission didn't go through. Nothing was sent; your credit is back.
toasts.practiceFailed: We couldn't start the practice run

stalled.title: This application stopped moving
stalled.body: Something on the organiser's side or ours got in the way before it finished. Try again; if it keeps happening, the error is already logged for us.

errors.conflict: This application just changed. Reload to see where it is now.
errors.insufficient_credits: You need 1 credit to submit this application.
errors.not_ready: This application isn't ready for that step yet.
errors.needs_confirmation: Nothing is submitted without your confirmation.
errors.invalid_transition: That step isn't possible from where this application is now.
errors.not_submitted: Record an outcome once the application has been submitted.
errors.busy: We're submitting this right now. Give it a moment.
errors.no_followup: There is no follow-up waiting for this application.
errors.invalid_answer: That answer doesn't fit this question.
errors.invalid_request: That request isn't valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.outreach_blocked: We can't send this email: the recipient can't be contacted right now.
errors.guardian_required: You're under 18: add a parent or guardian's email to your profile before your first submission.

outreach.do_not_contact: This person asked not to be contacted, so we won't write to them.
outreach.minor: Email outreach isn't available for high-school students. Use the prepared text with a parent or teacher instead.
outreach.recently_contacted: You wrote to this person in the last 30 days. We wait 30 days before writing to the same person again (from {date}).
outreach.invalid_email: That isn't an email address we can write to.
